title: lot.pending written by the legacy SAVE with only a qty (no kind/t) - save accepts what load rejects

legacy_observed.behaviour: save_state() accepted the qty-only pending record twice (no validation on write, engine.py:1806-1807 -> 1332), so primary AND .bak hold it; the reader rejects both (engine.py:582-585) -> both moved aside, failed_closed with ZERO lots; a new automatic ETHUSDT entry was SENT after resume. resume allowed by the app/telegram gate that checks install_block only (app.py:1225-1227, telegram_ctl.py:524); MANUAL entries pass while paused (engine.py:3415); untracked only after 2 reconcile passes (engine.py:3268-3272)

violates: D2 current damage: fail closed, keep evidence
D3 never an empty managed account
D4 explicit exchange/state reconciliation before management resumes
nc02_scenario: the committed snapshot holds an intent with only a quantity

nc02_required.R-WRITE-VALIDATES: every record is validated with the reader schema BEFORE commit; a record the reader would reject is never committed (the intent is refused and nothing is sent)
nc02_required.R-INTENT-SHAPE: an order intent carries kind, client id, created_ms (integer UTC ms) and a quantity that is > 0, a whole number of venue steps and <= the venue maximum; any other shape is refused at write time and is damage at read time
nc02_required.R-NO-EMPTY: an initialized account (marker or any store generation or evidence present) can never load as an empty portfolio; an empty portfolio is only legal for a first run whose exchange snapshot is flat (no positions, no open orders) or after an explicit owner adoption record
nc02_required.R-RECON-GATE: management (and every new-risk path, MANUAL included) stays blocked until a reconciliation record binds state generation G to an exchange snapshot that matches it (positions, open orders, protective orders) or the owner adopts/flattens each difference explicitly; resuming entries alone never clears it
nc02_required.R-HOLD: HOLD (Codex rulings 3 and 6): no new risk from any source (auto, manual, Telegram, UI, grid, maker); non-protective open intents are cancelled or drained through the priority queue; a late or partial fill is adopted and protected and stays blocked from new risk until reconciled; protective orders are kept; durable local append-only intent/result/incident events are allowed; no promotion and no reconciliation claim
